concerns.text: The specification references functional requirement identifiers FR-001 … FR-012 in the plan, but the spec file contains no FR definitions; the 'Requirements' section is empty and only shows placeholder text.
Success‑criterion identifiers SC-001 … SC-008 are referenced in the plan, yet the spec does not define any SC entries; the 'Success Criteria' section contains only a template placeholder.

The methodology claims that the Matbench HEA dataset provides `yield_strength` values, but Matbench’s public HEA benchmark does not contain experimentally measured yield‑strength data, creating a factual contradiction between the dataset description and its actual content.
